name: nc/repeater
title: Repeater
description: Repeats its one child, the row, for each row of a repeater field of the current post. Without rows it shows the empty text, if set.
aiHints: Use it to list the rows of a repeater field (for example lessons, steps, features). Add one child with nc/text or nc/container and bind each value to {"source":"item","field":"<subfield>"}; the item source also offers index (from 1). Set field to the repeater key of the model.
